x @ W1 @ W2 @ W3 = x @ (W1 W2 W3). Produ: x @ W1 @ W2 @ W3 = x @ (W1 W2 W3). The product of the matrices is a matrix. Only with a non-linearity in between does each layer add anything.

Negativa värden blir 0, positiva släpps: Negative values become 0, positive ones pass through. Each neuron becomes a detector that is either off or fires. The sum of many such kinks can shape any curve.

En vektor är bara en lista med tal, som: A vector is just a list of numbers, like a row in a spreadsheet. The dot product is a way to measure how similar two such lists are. It is the most common arithmetic step in the whole model.
En <b>vektor</b> är en lista med tal. I: A vector is a list of numbers. In the model every token is a vector of 4096 numbers, and such a vector can be seen as an arrow in a room with 4096 dimensions.
<b>Skalärprodukten</b> multiplicerar två: The dot product multiplies two vectors element by element and sums:
Resultatet är ett enda tal som mäter hur: The result is a single number that measures how much the vectors point in the same direction, scaled by their lengths.

Weights are the model’s learned numbers. They sit fixed in GPU memory and are the same for every question. They are the program.
<b>Aktiveringar</b> är mellanvärdena som: Activations are the intermediate values computed as a token passes through. They are the state while the program runs.
Vikterna är modellens kunskap: inlärda e: The weights are the model’s knowledge: learned once and then fixed. The activations are the model’s thoughts about your particular text, and they are computed again every time.
Den viktigaste distinktionen i hela kurs: The most important distinction in the whole course:
I en tät modell multipliceras <b>alla</b: In a dense model all weights are multiplied for every token. So you cannot see “which weights were activated” by a question. What separates one question from another is the activations, and those are what you study when you want to understand what the model is doing.
I en MoE-modell väljer en router några e: In an MoE model a router picks a few experts per token. There you can actually see which weight blocks were used.
